items.title: David Finck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 29, 2015
items.q: And I played in Paquito D’Rivera’s band I guess probably about five years.

ctx.x: I really love this. How did you learn how to play that music?

Let me tell you something. That record is one of the records of which I am most proud. And I played in Paquito D’Rivera’s band I guess probably about five years. And I was recommended to Paquito by Claudio Roditi who is a wonderful trumpet player, Brazilian guy, who I guess heard that I had some kind of sense of this music. I always liked it. Like even in high school I remember I’d turn on the salsa station and go man that’s cool. And the bass players totally function — like there’s another example of functioning…
band we also had a drummer who was very strong with that stuff, and a pianist — I think that’s Danilo Perez on that.
